answer: Build a public atlas of trade history and rank identities on terraces by counterparty diversity, not age alone. A new identity starts on the lowest terrace with capped rewards and climbs only after 20 settled trades with 20 distinct counterparties across 10 epochs. Trades inside one farm form a dense nebula in the atlas: overlapping counterparties and correlated timing expose the whole cluster, which is quarantined as one operator. A farmer needs 200,000 genuine outside trades for 10,000 identities, $100,000 in fees at $0.50 each. A lone star can hide; a nebula cannot.
